tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (15.2:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: matrix-green
tokens.usage: Active monitoring, system health, GO status. Used as shadow/glow on `.status-indicator`; text on `.stat-change.positive`, `.table-status.allowed`, `.footer-value.online`. 8.4:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: alert-red
tokens.usage: Critical threats, incidents, STOP status. Used as text on `.stat-change.negative`, `.cvss-score`, `.table-status.blocked`. 5.1:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: shield-blue
tokens.usage: Protection active, defenses operational. Used as text on `.card-action`, `.vuln-id`. 5.2:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: warning-amber
tokens.usage: Medium severity, attention required. Used as text on `.table-status.flagged`, `.severity-medium`. 8.9:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: border-hover
tokens.usage: Protection active, defenses operational. Used as shadow/glow on `.shield-icon`; background on `.stat-icon`, `.data-table tbody tr:hover`.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: High-contrast operational text. Used as text on `body`, `.section-title`, `.card-title`. 15.2:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting information, metadata. Used as text on `.header-status`, `.section-badge`, `.stat-label`. 7.6:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.footer-copyright`. 4.0:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: category-tag-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: background on `.category-tag`; border on `.category-tag`; text on `.category-tag`. 19.2:1 on `page-bg`.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero and page titles — as `h1.header-title` on the reference page.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section headings, set in uppercase — as `h2.section-title` on the reference page.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Card and module titles, set in uppercase — as `h3.card-title` on the reference page.

styles.name: heading-4
styles.usage: Minor headings, set in uppercase — as `h4.footer-title` on the reference page.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels, eyebrows and table headers, set in uppercase — as `span.stat-label` on the reference page.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body copy — as `td` on the reference page.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions and metadata — as `div.threat-meta` on the reference page.
